tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Base of every HUD panel and window. Always opaque over the map: no blur and no translucency on surfaces that sit over the canvas.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Rows, cards and secondary buttons inside a panel; the hot (hovered or pressed) state of rail and context buttons.

tokens.name: panel-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the unit grid, slider and meter tracks, inputs, the selected rail button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers between rows and sections and the inner rule of the double edge. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Panel outer edge and control borders. 3:1 or better against panel, and it separates the panel from the map.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on panel, panel-raised and panel-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions and secondary values on panel, panel-raised and panel-sunken (4.5:1 on all three).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brass. The one primary action per view (End turn, Buy new, Play, OK) and the active tab marker. In Paper it is 2.4:1 against panel, so an accent fill always keeps its line-strong border.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Brass as text: prestige amounts, the active tab label and links, on panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: axis
tokens.usage: Axis side color (field-grey blue) as a fill: side chip, strength badge, odds bar. Always with the nation's flag.

tokens.name: axis-ink
tokens.usage: Axis side color as text on panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: allied
tokens.usage: Allied side color (rust) as a fill, shared by Soviet, Polish, British, US and French forces. Always with the nation's flag.

tokens.name: allied-ink
tokens.usage: Allied side color as text on panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: neutral-side
tokens.usage: Neutral cities and objectives, unowned flags.

tokens.name: on-side
tokens.usage: Text on an axis, allied or neutral-side fill (strength numbers on badges).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Fuel and ammo above half, a positive delta, a won objective. Always with the ok glyph, a word or a bar length, never color alone.

tokens.name: low
tokens.usage: Fuel or ammo at a quarter to half, a costly result. Always with the low glyph.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Fuel or ammo under a quarter, out of supply, losses, an unfavourable attack, the rubber stamp. Always with the critical glyph or as a stamp word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset, so it sits on the panel and not on a fill. Distinct from accent so focus never reads as selection.

tokens.name: hex-select
tokens.usage: Outline of the selected unit's hex on the map, 3px solid.

tokens.name: hex-target
tokens.usage: Outline of the enemy hex the odds preview is showing, 3px dashed.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Flat dimming layer behind modal windows (equipment, dossier, messages). A flat color only, never backdrop-filter over the canvas.

tokens.name: photo-tint
tokens.usage: Layer over the start-menu photographs so the menu panel stays the strongest thing on screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and dossier headings, the picked campaign or scenario, the unit name in the equipment detail.

styles.name: unit-name
styles.usage: The unit name in the info panel and tooltips.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Rubber-stamp words in critical with a 2px border, rotated -4°. At most one per window.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Polish forces hold the Mława line. Break through before turn 9.
styles.usage: Briefings, descriptions, list items, the combat log.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Tanks move on their own tracks.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, tab captions and buttons, uppercase through CSS.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges and context-button captions only. The smallest text in the UI.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Typed values: turn, date, coordinates, costs, stats, the status line.

styles.name: typed
styles.sample: Take Mława and Ciechanów. Hold the Narew crossings.
styles.usage: Briefing body inside the message dialog, like a typed order sheet.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rail groups, grid gaps, stat cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding at 1366 wide, gap from the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding at 1920 wide and on tablet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Window padding and the gap between window sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Start menu and dossier margins.

tokens.name: radius-paper
tokens.usage: Panels, windows, buttons and inputs: near-square, like cut paper.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Index cards in the unit grid, wells, stat cells.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Toggle knobs, slider thumbs, the AI-status dot. Nothing else is round.

tokens.name: hit-target
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of anything tappable: rail buttons, context buttons, tabs, list rows, toggles.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon box inside a 44px button. Use 16px inline in text and 24px on tablet rails.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Width of the right game rail on desktop; 56px on tablet.

tokens.name: hex-w
tokens.usage: Map hex width at 100% zoom; columns step 45px.

tokens.name: hex-h
tokens.usage: Map hex height at 100% zoom.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Every HUD panel over the map. A cheap static box-shadow lifts the panel off busy terrain without blur filters.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Modal windows: equipment, dossier, message, menus.

tokens.name: z-map-overlay
tokens.usage: Hex outlines, small unit tooltips, map pins.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: Status bar, rail, unit info, unit list, End turn.

tokens.name: z-context
tokens.usage: Unit context menu and the odds preview.

tokens.name: z-window
tokens.usage: Equipment, combat log, dossier, with the scrim one below.

tokens.name: z-message
tokens.usage: Message dialog and the start menu.
